sources.title: Retail discounts
sources.scope: Official full page fetched and reviewed in the approved research: Manage discounts, concurrency, pricing priority, line type, unit of measure and best practices.
supported_claims: Status, currency, unit and product/channel scope affect discount applicability.
Exclusive, best-price and compounded modes interact with pricing priority.
A discount strategy should be documented and configuration tested before enablement.
sources.limitations: The actual pricing engine includes broader contextual and basket-dependent rules than this single-unit synthetic audit. This file procedure does not claim complete Dynamics pricing-engine compatibility; its precise hierarchy and export schema are sample policy.

sources.title: Pricing settings
sources.scope: Official full page fetched and reviewed in the approved research: concurrency control, discount compound behavior, line rounding and deprecated/removed settings.
supported_claims: Different concurrency settings change whether discounts compound within or across priorities.
Compounding successively versus applying each discount to original price can change the result.
Line discount rounding/distribution behavior is configurable.
The old Enable price report for retail store setting was removed in October 2023.
sources.limitations: Final ROUND_HALF_UP rounding, tolerance, highest-priority-only competition, amount-before-percent compounding and exact tie ordering are explicit sample choices, not universal product behavior. No deprecated setup instruction is executed.

sources.title: Retail price reports
sources.scope: Official full page fetched and reviewed in the approved research: store/date report overview, configuration, export and historical-price description.
supported_claims: Store managers can review recent or upcoming product price changes by store and date.
Reports can support historical-price checks and export for further filtering.
sources.limitations: The page's old enable-parameter instruction is superseded by r7's October 2023 removal note. Only reporting concepts are used. The documented seven-day product-feature limit is not a universal file-audit requirement. No report setup, installed-product claim or live access is inferred.
